description: Finds the reviewed Cradle guides that best match a parenting question (pregnancy, babies, toddlers, preschoolers and family life). Returns each guide's id, title, summary and page link, plus its when-to-call line. Also flags an urgent question the same way get_help does. Read a result in full with read_guide.

query.description: The question or topic, in plain words.

stage.description: Optional: only guides for this stage.

name: search_guides
title: Search Cradle's parenting guides
